title: ZAC Investigators and the Case of the Dinosaur Tracks
author: Kos Scribe

archive.primary: ZAC Investigators and the Case of the Dinosaur Tracks.html

description: When Zee finds some strange footprints in the mud down by the creek, it is up to Zac Investigators to get to the bottom of it.  Who made them, and where did they come from?  Is there really a dinosaur roaming around the streets?  Find out, as Zee and Charlie embark on the Case of the Dinosaur Tracks.
